whenToUse: Website top navigation: corporate, restaurant split, minimal, SaaS.
Server-rendered navbars with a zero-JS mobile menu.
avoidWhen: Admin apps — use App shell with Sidebar/Top bar.
Mega menus with rich panels — use Navigation Menu.
a11y: A labelled nav landmark; the current page has aria-current.
The mobile menu button has an accessible name and expanded state.
